# Loadings

## 1.1 Libraries of functions: 

I uploaded data and packages of necessary functions to perform the calculations, and set the working directory.

```{r, setup, results=FALSE, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE)
package_to_load <- c("readxl", "readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyr", "dplyr","RColorBrewer", "car", "gplots")
for (package in package_to_load) {
  require(package, character.only = T); packageVersion(package)
}
extra_to_load <- c("knitr","stringr", "stringi", "ggrepel","ggpubr", "ggbreak","reshape2","ggfortify","cowplot","pheatmap","Seurat","data.table","Matrix")
for (package in extra_to_load) {
  require(package, character.only = T); packageVersion(package)
}
rm(package_to_load, extra_to_load)
```

## 1.2 Tables

First, I load the predicted values and their estandard error.

```{r}
hba1c <- read_excel("/Volumes/ELENA_3/IDIBAPS/Macarena/Book1_adapted_Elena.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Plot")
rownames(hba1c) <- hba1c$...1
hba1c_t <- as.data.frame(t(hba1c))
hba1c_t <- hba1c_t[-1,]
hba1c_t <- as.data.frame(apply(hba1c_t,2,as.numeric))
rownames(hba1c_t) <- colnames(hba1c)[-1]
hba1c_t$Category <- rownames(hba1c_t)
hba1c_t <- hba1c_t %>% arrange(Category)
```

Second table is the one with the confidence intervals:
```{r}
hba1c_ci <- read_excel("/Volumes/ELENA_3/IDIBAPS/Macarena/Book1_adapted_Elena.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Conf_Int")
rownames(hba1c_ci) <- hba1c_ci$...1
hba1c_tci <- as.data.frame(t(hba1c_ci))
hba1c_tci <- hba1c_tci[-1,]
hba1c_tci <- as.data.frame(apply(hba1c_tci,2,as.numeric))
rownames(hba1c_tci) <- colnames(hba1c_ci)[-1]
hba1c_tci$Category <- rownames(hba1c_tci)
hba1c_tci <- hba1c_tci %>% arrange(Category)
hba1c_tci <- left_join(hba1c_tci,hba1c_t,by="Category")
```


# 2. Plots

First, I plot the predicted values and the corresonding standard error:


The second plot corresponds to the confidence interval:
```{r}
df <- reshape2::melt(hba1c_tci[,1:3])
order_donations <-as.factor(c("At least once a week","Less than weekly, at least monthly","Less often than once a month","Never","At least once a week","Less than weekly, at least monthly","Less often than once a month","Never"))
order_donations2 <-as.factor(c("At least once a week","At least once a week","Less than weekly, at least monthly","Less than weekly, at least monthly","Less often than once a month","Less often than once a month","Never","Never"))
df$order_donations3 <- c(1,3,2,4,1,3,2,4)

pdf(file = "Paper_maca_HBA1C_conf_int.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
ggplot(df, aes(x=reorder(Category, order_donations3), y=value, fill=variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(), colour='black') +
#  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=HBA1C-hba1c_t$`Std. Err`, ymax=HBA1C+hba1c_t$`Std. Err`), width=.2) +geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color = "gray")+
  labs(x = "Donations frequency", y= "HBA1C\n(dy/dx)",fill="Category") + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "PuOr") +
  theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
dev.off()

pdf(file = "Paper_maca_HBA1C_conf_int_rotated.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
ggplot(df, aes(y=reorder(Category, order_donations3), x=value, fill=variable)) +

  labs(y = "Donations frequency", x= "",fill="Category") + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "PuOr") +
  theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
dev.off()
```
